draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kundapura! This Udupi district town is known for its own dialect of Kannada and its great food, and it's said chicken ghee roast was invented right here.
draft.hungryLine: Kundapur means chicken ghee roast, ghee rice and fish fried in coconut oil, with plenty of pure veg spots too.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Kodi Beach is just 1 km from town, and Sri Laxmi Venkatesha Temple is about a kilometre away too.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to Maravanthe Beach, where the sea and the Suparnika River run side by side.
moodReplies.surprise-me: At Maravanthe, the Suparnika River flows parallel to the Arabian Sea and then makes a U-turn west to join it.

spots.name: Kodi Beach

spots.name: Maravanthe Beach
spots.detail: On the coast · Sea on one side, river on the other

spots.name: Sri Laxmi Venkatesha Temple
spots.detail: 1 km from town · A local temple

legends.title: Birthplace of ghee roast
legends.body: Locals will tell you chicken ghee roast was invented at Shetty Lunch Home. Wikivoyage says it's still the best in the country.

tips.title: Get to Shetty Lunch Home before 3PM.
tips.body: Lunch runs before 3PM, and you can call an hour ahead to have the ghee roast made fresh.

tips.title: Catch a Yakshagana show.
tips.body: It's the popular local traditional theatre, so ask around for a performance.

story.title: Yakshagana country
story.body: Yakshagana, the popular local traditional theatrical art, is part of life around Kundapur.

story.title: Gateway to Kollur
story.body: Kundapura railway station on the Konkan Railway is the quickest way for pilgrims, many from Kerala, to reach the Kollur Mookambika Temple.

story.title: A college town too
story.body: I. M. Jayarama Shetty founded the Moodlakatte Institute of Technology in 2004, about 200 metres from the station.

story.title: Dialect and food
story.body: Kundapur is known for its unique dialect of Kannada and great food.
